title: Pointwise Hölder continuity of Lyapunov exponents of random matrix products
summary: We prove that if the first Lyapunov exponent of a compactly supported random matrix product is simple, then it is pointwise Hölder continuous for the Wasserstein--Hausdorff distance. By passing to exterior powers, we obtain pointwise Hölder continuity of the first $k$ exponents whenever they are simple.
